stele.inscription.v: WELCOME TO THE SKY-ISLAND SANCTUARY. Every crag, fluted column, pierced lancet arch, mirror pool, and floating lantern here is authored as continuous OntoMath geometry, surface pigment fields, participating cloud media, and reactive Laws. Walk across the South Bridge and touch the Pearl of Dawn to awaken the sanctuary.

displayName.v: Stele of the Morning Star — Causal Rendering & Light

stele.inscription.v: EAST OBSERVATORY TERRACE. Light in this sanctuary descends from authored FieldNodes: the Sun of the Living Dawn casts spatially bounded scalar and chromatic radiance, while the Sea of Clouds below and Clerestory Mist within the pavilion scatter and occlude it.

displayName.v: Stele of the Living Wind — Organic Form from Pure Mathematics

stele.inscription.v: WEST ARBOR GROVE. The Ancient Sky-Cedar and the five island crags use zero triangle meshes or hardcoded domain classes: their silhouettes emerge from SmoothUnion and Subtract CSG compositions paired with continuous OntoMath surface color fields.

displayName.v: Stele of the Horizon — Process as Law

stele.inscription.v: NORTH ZENITH SANCTUM. When you click the Pearl Touchstone in the main court, five authored Laws govern the sanctuary: an OnEvent trigger flips intention, exponential flow integrates resonance over time, and continuous Map laws bloom the 12 Lotus Petals and ring the Sky-Bell.
